title: 金链名伶
prompt: Use case: photorealistic high-end international fashion magazine editorial (Vogue / Harper's Bazaar style) pet portrait, shot by a top fashion photographer in a professional indoor studio. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same adult Chinchilla Persian cat from Image 1, with long silver-tipped white fur, flat sweet face and black-rimmed green eyes. One pet only, no people. Wear exactly the garments and accessories named in the set description, tailored and clearly visible; nothing else. Set and light: A luxury magazine portrait against a warm stone-grey plaster backdrop, beside the fluted top of a white marble classical column. Half-body framing from head to chest. The cat sits in elegant profile with its chin lifted, then slides its eyes toward the camera with a cool, haughty diva gaze. The cat wears a fitted black ribbed turtleneck and a heavy layered gold chain necklace resting on its chest. Soft but directional key light from camera right, refined shadows, polished editorial color. The cat sits in profile with chin lifted and slides its eyes toward the camera with a haughty diva gaze. Photographic qualities: a single dominant light source with one consistent direction, natural soft falloff into shadow, true-to-life fur with individual strands and slight natural unevenness, realistic eye moisture with one small catchlight, believable contact shadow where the body meets the surface. Camera: medium-format fashion camera with a 100mm lens at about f/4, eye-level, crisp detail on the face and coat. Controlled professional studio lighting, refined color grading like a printed magazine spread, deep clean tones, no HDR look, no plastic retouching. Attitude matters most: handsome, noble and commanding like a top fashion model on a magazine cover, with a strong pose and a cool, self-assured, slightly aloof expression, so that any pet owner would want this cover shot of their own pet. Indoor studio only, never outdoors, never a wide landscape. Vertical 3:4 half-body portrait from head to chest, the pet large in frame, with one or two real set pieces partly visible beside it so the backdrop is not empty. Avoid: outdoor scenery, nature backgrounds, messy cluttered sets, full-body tiny pet, cute or goofy expressions, dull muddy tones, blank or sleepy expression, human-like poses, cartoonish costumes, hats, multiple accessories, glowing or rim light that looks painted, dramatic fantasy lighting, oversaturated colors, plastic or airbrushed fur, perfect symmetry, extra props, floating body, pasted edges, extra limbs, duplicate pets, CGI or illustration look, text, logos or watermark. Return one photograph only.
